authority: Alias registry over canonical typed Mandala addresses; typed IDs remain primary.
orderingLaw: SEC first in angular order S01..S72; then LAY L01..L06; then GRP G01..G09; then Rose Mothers M01..M03, Doubles D01..D07, Simples S01..S12.

machineEncodingV1.ordinalRule: zero-based ordinal inside namespace encoded in 7 bits; unused ordinal values are invalid/reserved
machineEncodingV1.hexRule: 14-bit frame is left-padded to 16 bits for 4-hex-digit transport; the two high padding bits MUST be 00
machineEncodingV1.warning: AK-### is human alias only. Lossless machine authority is the typed frame.

topologyRules: SEC:Snn has angular neighbors SEC:S(n-1) and SEC:S(n+1), modulo 72.
LAY:Lnn has radial neighbors previous/next layer where defined.
MF:Lxx:Syy is a composite intersection of one LAY and one SEC and is not an additional primitive AK.
GRP:Gnn contains exactly eight consecutive SEC sectors in V1.
R22 Mothers, Doubles and Simples form three ordered cyclic families; exact source-to-Hebrew rotation for Doubles/Simples remains a correspondence attribute, not an address identity.
CORE remains reserved outside AK-001..AK-109 until its topology is canonically frozen.

pathGrammarV1.node: typed AK address or canonical composite MF address
pathGrammarV1.canonicalRequirement: Every future canonical glyph must store its ordered PATH independently of its rendered image.
